description.value:
Actions 10 minutes

Frequency once per day

Traits Signal, auditory, divination

Name an event aloud, specifically enough that the GM can identify it. If any recording of that event exists or ever existed anywhere, you play back its sound for everyone present, and the GM decides what such a recording would have caught — including nothing, if the recorder was too far away or facing the wrong way. There is no check and no saving throw. If no recording was ever made, you hear silence and the use is still expended.
